copy.page_title: Upgrade your Vision Plus | GreenBay x Vision Plus
copy.description: Trade in your old Vision Plus appliance or TV for Vision Plus credit. GreenBay values it, checks it and buys it. You spend the credit on something new from Vision Plus.
copy.headline_2: Your old one pays towards it.
copy.lede: Tell us about your old Vision Plus TV or appliance and we will make you a fair offer, paid as Vision Plus credit. GreenBay checks the item and buys it from you. You spend the credit on anything new from Vision Plus.
copy.run_by: Valued and bought by GreenBay Second Life Appliances
copy.card_note: Example only. Your offer depends on your TV or appliance.
copy.card_item: Vision Plus 43 inch TV, 3 years old

steps.title: Tell us about it
steps.body: Four short steps: what it is, how old it is, its condition, and a few photos. It takes about two minutes.

steps.title: See your offer
steps.body: We value it against real resale prices and show you a figure in Vision Plus credit. Every Vision Plus item we accept is worth at least KES 500.

steps.title: We check it
steps.body: Our team calls you to arrange a check. For fridges, washing machines and TVs of 50 inches and up, a GreenBay technician comes to you. Smaller items can be dropped at a GreenBay shop.

steps.title: Spend it at Vision Plus
steps.body: Once the check is done, your credit is ready. Use it at Vision Plus within 90 days and pay the difference on your new TV or appliance.

credit_rows: Vision Plus credit equal to your accepted offer, and never less than KES 500.

copy.accepts: Old Vision Plus TVs, fridges and freezers, cookers and ovens, microwaves, washing machines and small kitchen appliances. Working or not.
copy.eval_sub: Four short steps. Kay, our evaluator, keeps you company as you go.
faq: Does it have to be a Vision Plus?
Yes. This swap is for Vision Plus products. For other brands, GreenBay can still make you a cash offer at evaluate.greenbay.market.
Yes. For TVs, a short video of the screen switched on helps us value it fairly. You can add one with your photos.
What if it is very old or not working?
Send it in anyway. Every Vision Plus item we accept is worth at least KES 500 in credit. What we cannot resell is stripped for parts or recycled.
What if the check finds something different?
Our team talks it through with you before anything is final. No credit is issued until you agree.
How do I get my credit?
Once your item has been checked, our customer team calls you with your Vision Plus credit code.
copy.footer_legal: GreenBay Second Life Appliances values, inspects and buys your old item. New Vision Plus products are sold and delivered by Vision Plus (Kryptonite International Limited). The Vision Plus name and logo belong to their owner.
copy.greeting: Hi, I'm Kay from GreenBay. I'll value your old Vision Plus for the swap. Four short steps and you will see your offer.
copy.step1_title: Tell us about your old Vision Plus
copy.step1_hint: Three quick picks. It takes about 20 seconds.
copy.step1_category_label: Which Vision Plus product is it?
copy.step2_hint: Start with a photo of the label, so we can read the model number. Then add at least 3 photos. For a TV, a short video of the screen on helps too.
copy.buy_title: What would you like from Vision Plus?
copy.buy_hint: Pick one. It helps Vision Plus have it ready for you.
copy.price_hint: Any figure in mind for your old one? (optional)
copy.offer_note: Paid as Vision Plus credit, not cash. It is ready once our team has checked your item, and lasts 90 days from then.
